_readme: Curated boss roster for /bosses/ pages. Keyed by WZ mob ID (stable across dossier ID variants). Editorial fields (tldr, access, strategy, threat) are hand-written; combat stats, drops, and spawn maps come from mobs.json at build time, where stats are the Classic World client values (osmsdataexplorer monsters.json). Keep any numbers in the prose in sync with those - they were rewritten on 2026-10-22 after a switch from GMS v83 stats exposed large differences (e.g. Jr. Balrog Lv 55 / 30,000 HP in v83 vs Lv 80 / 325,400 HP in Classic World). Optional 'theme' overrides region auto-detection. 'liveRoster' marks bosses on Nexon's live roster: the Founder's Access five (Oct 3 notes) plus King Slime (Kerning PQ), kept at Grand Launch, which added Stumpy (Oct 20 notes).

narrative.tldr: New on the Grand Launch roster. Lv 35, 19,220 HP, and 276 EXP in the Classic World client, in Parched Land off East Rocky Mountain V near Perion. The Perion quest 'Monstrous Tree Stumpy' (Lv 34+) asks you to defeat him once.
narrative.access: Parched Land connects to East Rocky Mountain V. Respawn timing isn't in the client data; if he's down, check other channels.
narrative.strategy: Stumpy is weak to Fire and strong against Lightning, so Fire/Poison Wizards deal bonus damage while Ice/Lightning Wizards should lean on non-lightning spells. His 477 attack and 524 magic attack hit hard for Lv 35 - party up or come in over-leveled. Community-reported drops include crafting catalysts, Elixirs, Sap of Ancient Tree, and the Stumpy Figure.

narrative.tldr: Lv 48, 47,000 HP, and 488 EXP in the Classic World client, met through the Henesys Citizenship quest 'An Old Grudge' in the Cabin of the Forsaken. An earlier version of this page described a 4,800 HP ghost with 999 evasion; the client data shows 35 avoidability.
narrative.access: Pick up 'An Old Grudge' from Arthur in Henesys after Lv 47 (part of the Henesys Citizenship chain). The quest sends you to the Cabin of the Forsaken, a hidden map off the standard Henesys-area routing. Quest-gated, not a free-roam world boss. One kill per questline; not repeatable.
narrative.strategy: Shade is weak to Holy and strong against Poison: a Cleric's Holy Arrow does bonus damage, and Fire/Poison Wizards should skip their poison spells. With 620 attack and 682 magic attack at Lv 48, bring potions and a healer if you can.

narrative.tldr: Lv 40, 34,440 HP, and 340 EXP in the Classic World client (traditional MapleStory had her at Lv 60 with 20,000 HP). Spawns in Someone Else's House. Community-reported drops are led by Ilbi Throwing Stars, plus Mushmom Spores, Elixirs, and crafting catalysts.
narrative.access: Spawns in Someone Else's House on Victoria Island. If she's not up, check other channels. Loot goes to whoever finds her by player convention; we can't confirm any engine-level ownership rule.
narrative.strategy: She's weak to Fire, so Fire/Poison Wizards deal bonus damage. With 532 attack and 585 magic attack at Lv 40, bring a party or a healthy potion budget.

narrative.tldr: Lv 55, 66,640 HP, and 668 EXP in the Classic World client, in The Grave of Mushmom. Undead and weak to Holy. Community-reported drops include Poisonous Mushrooms, crafting catalysts, and Ilbi Throwing Stars.
narrative.access: Spawns in The Grave of Mushmom on Victoria Island. If she's down, check other channels.
narrative.strategy: Holy is her weakness, so a Cleric's Holy Arrow does bonus damage - bring one if you can. With 697 attack and 766 magic attack, expect to need potions even in a party.

narrative.tldr: Catalogued in the Classic World client at Lv 100 with 741,240 HP and 6,000 EXP, but on neither the Founder's Access nor the Grand Launch roster, and the data has no spawn location for him. Treat everything about how he'll appear as unconfirmed until Nexon adds him.
narrative.access: Not live. In traditional MapleStory he ambushed the ship from Ellinia to Orbis; Classic World hasn't announced when or how he'll appear.
narrative.strategy: No live strategy yet. Per the client data he's immune to Poison and weak to Holy; at Lv 100 with 741,240 HP he would be by far the strongest boss in the data.

narrative.tldr: Lv 80 with 325,400 HP and 2,188 EXP in the Classic World client - not the Lv 55, 30,000 HP boss of traditional MapleStory. He waits in The Cursed Sanctuary and is the hardest live boss on the roster by a wide margin.
narrative.access: Spawns in The Cursed Sanctuary, deep in the Sleepywood dungeon. Respawn timing isn't in the client data.
narrative.strategy: Treat him as a full-party fight near the level cap. He's immune to Poison and weak to Holy, with 972 attack and 1,069 magic attack. At 325,400 HP a party in the 70s or higher with healers is the realistic setup; under-leveled groups run out of potions first. Community-reported drops are modest so far: crafting catalysts, potions, Elixirs, and Hwabi Throwing Stars.

narrative.tldr: The final stage of the Kerning City Party Quest ('First Time Together', Channels 3 - 12). Lv 32, 16,820 HP, and 2,400 EXP in the Classic World client - matching what the MapleClassic Wiki reported during Founder's Access. Beating him unlocks the clear.
narrative.access: Complete KPQ stages 1-4 (trivia / ropes / cats-on-logs / barrels) with a party of 3-6 (levels 21-30). King Slime spawns in the Last Stage along with 6 Jr. Necki + 3 Curse Eye. Each mob drops 1 Pass; leader hands all 10 Passes to Cloto to clear. No solo access - PQ-only fight.
narrative.strategy: King Slime is strong against Fire, Ice, Lightning, and Holy, so elemental spells hit for reduced damage - Magic Claw (no element) and physical attacks are the reliable damage. Healers stay back. Per the MapleClassic Wiki he summons Slimes at half HP and splits into Slimes on death; clear the adds with area attacks so your healer isn't swamped.

narrative.tldr: The first boss most characters meet. Lv 20 with 7,420 HP in the Classic World client - almost four times the 2,000 HP of traditional MapleStory - so a solo Lv 20 fight takes a real potion budget. Spawns in Thicket Around the Beach III.
narrative.access: Spawns in Thicket Around the Beach III on Victoria Island. Respawn timing isn't in the client data; if he's down, check other channels.
narrative.strategy: Mano has no elemental weaknesses or resistances and only 13 avoidability, so any class connects reliably. His 252 attack is high for Lv 20 - bring potions and expect a few minutes of trading hits. Community-reported drops include the Rainbow-colored Snail Shell and crafting catalysts.
